modules.name: Environment & Tooling
modules.description: VS Code, Python virtual environments, local LLM setup with Ollama, Qwen2.5-Coder, GitHub Copilot, Cline, FastAPI, React + Vite, and Git/GitHub repository initialization.
topics: VS Code & Python Virtual Environment Setup (.venv)
Local LLM Execution with Ollama & Qwen2.5-Coder
AI Assistant Workflow Integration with Copilot & Cline
First AI Application: FastAPI Backend + React Vite Frontend + Git
learningObjectives: Configure VS Code with Pylance and Python virtual environments
Install and execute local models offline using Ollama CLI
Build a full-stack chatbot connecting React frontend with FastAPI backend
Publish clean git repository code to GitHub

modules.name: Data Foundations
modules.description: Reading & processing structured data (Pandas, SQLite, SQL, SQLAlchemy) and unstructured data (pdfplumber, PyPDF, python-docx, Tesseract OCR, BeautifulSoup, Requests, LangChain Text Splitters, JSONL).
topics: Structured Data Processing with Pandas & SQLite
Unstructured Document Ingestion (PDF, Word, OCR & Web Scraping)
Knowledge Base Construction & Metadata-Enriched Text Chunking
learningObjectives: Clean and store structured datasets in SQLite using Pandas & SQLAlchemy
Extract, normalize, and OCR text from healthcare PDFs, Word docs, and web pages
Chunk long documents with LangChain splitters and export JSONL knowledge bases

modules.name: Embeddings & Vector Search
modules.description: Understanding text embeddings (Sentence Transformers, OpenAI Embeddings, Scikit-learn, PCA clustering), Vector DB setup (ChromaDB, Pinecone), indexing, semantic search, and query routing (SQL vs Vector Search).
topics: Vector Embeddings & Dimensionality Reduction (PCA Clustering)
Vector Databases Setup & Indexing (ChromaDB vs Pinecone)
Semantic Search & Hybrid Query Routing (SQL + Vector Search)
learningObjectives: Convert text chunks into dense vector embeddings using Sentence Transformers
Set up local ChromaDB and cloud Pinecone indexes for semantic search
Build a hybrid query router deciding between SQL structured queries and vector search

modules.name: LLM Core, Prompting & Fine-Tuning
modules.description: RAG End-to-End, LLM API integration (OpenAI SDK, Ollama, Groq), prompt engineering (zero-shot, few-shot, Chain-of-Thought), function calling, Pydantic structured output, and LoRA/QLoRA fine-tuning.
topics: End-to-End RAG Pipeline & OpenAI/Ollama API Integration
Prompt Engineering Patterns (CoT, Few-Shot, System Templates)
Function Calling & Pydantic Structured Output Validation
Fine-Tuning Concepts & Hands-On LoRA/QLoRA Parameter Efficient Fine-Tuning
learningObjectives: Connect retrieval engines to local and hosted LLM APIs using OpenAI-compatible SDKs
Design function-calling schemas with automatic tool execution and Pydantic validation
Train fine-tuned models using PEFT, BitsAndBytes, and LoRA for domain consistency

modules.name: Chatbot Application Build
modules.description: Chatbot API endpoint construction (/chat), Streamlit/React frontend, Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming responses, Pydantic/Markdown rich response formatting, and SQLite session memory token management.
topics: FastAPI /chat API Endpoint & Conversation State Management
Interactive Frontend Development (Streamlit / React)
Real-Time Streaming Responses (StreamingResponse & Server-Sent Events)
Rich Output Formatting (Citations, Markdown Cards) & Conversation Token Truncation
learningObjectives: Build FastAPI endpoints supporting multi-session conversation history
Implement SSE token streaming for real-time typewriter output
Format rich markdown responses with citations and token context summarization

modules.name: Agentic AI & MCP
modules.description: LangChain Agents & ReAct reasoning loops, Multi-Agent Orchestration (CrewAI, LangGraph), Model Context Protocol (MCP SDK, Claude Desktop, Cline), and agentic pipeline integration with failure retries.
topics: ReAct Reasoning Loops & LangChain Agent Tool Wrapping
Multi-Agent Orchestration & Router Delegation (CrewAI & LangGraph)
Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server Development & Client Integration
Agentic Pipeline Integration with Failure Retries & Error Recovery
learningObjectives: Build ReAct reasoning agents capable of automatic tool selection
Orchestrate multi-agent workflows using LangGraph and specialist agents
Expose chatbot capabilities via standardized Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers

modules.name: Evaluation, Security & Deployment
modules.description: Automated evaluation benchmarks, token usage & latency optimization (tiktoken, response caching), security & prompt injection guardrails, and containerized Docker & Kubernetes deployment.
topics: Automated Chatbot Evaluation & Grounding Benchmarks
Performance Optimization, Latency & Token Cost Management
Security Guardrails, Input Validation & Prompt Injection Defense
Containerization & Orchestration with Docker & Kubernetes
learningObjectives: Evaluate chatbot accuracy, grounding, and retrieval quality against benchmarks
Implement response caching and token optimization with tiktoken
Containerize full-stack backend and frontend applications for Kubernetes deployment

modules.name: Production & Capstone
modules.description: Structured logging & observability (Prometheus, Grafana), production readiness testing, and final enterprise capstone project demonstration.
topics: Production Observability & Metrics (Prometheus & Grafana)
End-to-End Failure Testing & Production Hardening
Enterprise Capstone Showcase & Production Deployment
learningObjectives: Add structured logging and metric dashboards with Prometheus and Grafana
Conduct end-to-end failure testing and operational readiness validation
Demonstrate complete enterprise AI application with full architecture

days.title: VS Code & Python Environment Setup
objectives: Install VS Code and Python on your machine
Configure the Python extension and Pylance
Create and activate a project virtual environment (.venv)
Run and debug your first Python program inside VS Code
Verify the development environment is ready for the remaining course

days.title: Local LLM & AI Coding Assistant Setup
objectives: Install Ollama and download a local coding model
Verify the local model works through the Ollama CLI
Connect VS Code to the local model using GitHub Copilot or Cline
Generate code using the local AI assistant
Confirm the complete AI coding workflow works offline

days.title: First AI Project, React Frontend & GitHub
objectives: Build a command-line chatbot powered by your local Ollama model
Scaffold a FastAPI backend with a health endpoint
Create a React application using Vite
Connect the React frontend with the FastAPI backend
Initialize Git, commit the project, and publish it to GitHub

days.title: Reading & Processing Structured Data
objectives: Create synthetic healthcare plans and claims datasets
Load and clean structured CSV data using Pandas
Store the processed data in a SQLite database
Write SQL queries to answer common healthcare questions
Document reusable SQL queries for later chatbot integration

days.title: Reading & Processing Unstructured Data
objectives: Extract text from healthcare PDFs and Word documents
Perform OCR on scanned enrollment forms
Scrape useful content from a public healthcare webpage
Clean and normalize extracted text from multiple sources
Store the processed text files for knowledge-base creation

days.title: Building the Knowledge Base
objectives: Convert structured and unstructured healthcare data into a unified knowledge base
Split long documents into retrieval-friendly chunks
Attach metadata such as source, plan type, and document section to every chunk
Export all processed records into a knowledge_base.jsonl file
Validate chunk quality before using them for embeddings

days.title: Embeddings Explained
objectives: Understand how text is converted into vector embeddings
Generate embeddings for every knowledge base chunk
Store embeddings alongside the original documents
Visualize embedding clusters using PCA
Analyze whether similar healthcare concepts cluster together

days.title: Vector Databases Overview
objectives: Learn the role of vector databases in RAG applications
Set up a local Chroma vector database
Create a cloud-based Pinecone index for comparison
Compare local and managed vector database solutions
Select the most suitable database for the chatbot project

days.title: Building & Populating the Vector Database
objectives: Load knowledge base embeddings into the vector database
Store documents together with metadata for filtering
Verify that every knowledge base chunk has been indexed
Test semantic search with healthcare-related questions
Evaluate retrieval quality and metadata filtering

days.title: The Retrieval & Matching Engine
objectives: Build a query router that decides between SQL, vector search, or hybrid retrieval
Implement structured data lookup for plans and claims
Implement semantic retrieval from the vector database
Merge and deduplicate results from multiple retrieval sources
Evaluate retrieval accuracy using a diverse set of healthcare questions

days.title: RAG End-to-End & LLM API Basics
objectives: Connect the retrieval engine to an LLM to build a complete RAG pipeline
Configure a local or hosted LLM provider using the OpenAI-compatible SDK
Create a grounded prompt that answers only from retrieved context
Generate answers using retrieved knowledge
Evaluate chatbot responses against the retrieval-only baseline

days.title: Prompt Engineering Fundamentals
objectives: Understand zero-shot, few-shot, and chain-of-thought prompting
Design multiple system prompt variations for the chatbot
Compare prompts based on accuracy, compliance, and tone
Evaluate prompt performance using a fixed question set
Finalize the production-ready system prompt

days.title: Advanced Prompting: Function Calling & Structured Outputs
objectives: Define tool schemas for healthcare-related chatbot functions
Implement LLM function calling with automatic tool execution
Validate structured outputs using Pydantic models
Log tool calls for debugging and auditing
Test different user queries to verify correct tool selection

days.title: Fine-Tuning: Concepts & When to Use It
objectives: Understand when fine-tuning is more appropriate than prompting or RAG
Identify chatbot issues that fine-tuning can solve
Create a high-quality fine-tuning dataset
Validate and organize the dataset into training and test sets
Prepare the project for model fine-tuning

days.title: Fine-Tuning: Hands-On with LoRA & QLoRA
objectives: Train or fine-tune an LLM using LoRA or the OpenAI fine-tuning workflow
Load and evaluate the fine-tuned model
Compare the base model and fine-tuned model on unseen test cases
Measure improvements in tone, consistency, and response quality
Document whether fine-tuning provides measurable benefits for the chatbot

days.title: Chatbot Backend & API Integration
objectives: Create a /chat API endpoint for the healthcare chatbot
Integrate retrieval, function calling, and LLM response generation
Implement session-based conversation management
Build a conversation history endpoint
Test the complete backend API using Postman or cURL

days.title: Chatbot Frontend Development
objectives: Build an interactive chat interface for the chatbot
Connect the frontend to the backend chat API
Maintain conversation history across user interactions
Add a healthcare plan selector and new conversation option
Validate end-to-end communication between frontend and backend

days.title: Full-Stack Integration & Streaming Responses
objectives: Implement real-time streaming responses from the LLM
Display generated tokens incrementally in the chat interface
Add loading indicators for a better user experience
Handle interrupted or failed streaming requests gracefully
Verify smooth end-to-end streaming between backend and frontend

days.title: Response Formatting & Rich Outputs
objectives: Add citations to chatbot responses using retrieved knowledge
Create structured cards for claims and coverage summaries
Render Markdown content with tables, lists, and formatting
Validate structured outputs before displaying them
Improve chatbot readability and response trustworthiness

days.title: Conversation Memory & Context Management
objectives: Persist conversation history across multiple user sessions
Build context-aware conversations using previous messages
Implement automatic conversation summarization for long chats
Manage token limits while preserving important context
Ensure the chatbot remembers user preferences throughout a conversation

days.title: Agentic Frameworks: LangChain Agents & Tool Use
objectives: Convert function-calling workflows into a reasoning agent
Wrap chatbot capabilities as reusable LangChain tools
Build a ReAct agent capable of selecting the correct tool automatically
Analyze reasoning traces to understand agent decision making
Evaluate whether the agent chooses the right tools for healthcare queries

days.title: Multi-Agent Orchestration
objectives: Create specialized agents for different healthcare domains
Build a router agent that delegates requests to the correct specialist
Implement a complete multi-agent workflow
Compare multi-agent performance with a single-agent architecture
Identify scenarios where multiple agents provide measurable benefits

days.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
objectives: Understand the purpose of the Model Context Protocol
Build an MCP server exposing healthcare chatbot tools
Connect the MCP server to an MCP-compatible client
Expose multiple chatbot capabilities through standardized MCP tools
Verify successful tool execution through live MCP interactions

days.title: Agentic Chatbot Integration
objectives: Integrate agents, MCP tools, retrieval, and conversation memory
Replace mock tools with live MCP-powered tool calls
Implement retries, timeouts, and graceful error handling
Perform failure testing to validate chatbot reliability
Build a production-style agentic chatbot pipeline

days.title: Chatbot Evaluation & Testing
objectives: Create a benchmark dataset covering representative healthcare questions
Evaluate chatbot responses for accuracy, grounding, and consistency
Measure retrieval quality and end-to-end response performance
Identify common failure cases and document improvement areas
Establish baseline metrics before production deployment

days.title: Performance Optimization & Cost Management
objectives: Measure token usage across the chatbot pipeline
Optimize retrieval and prompt size to reduce latency and cost
Implement response caching for repeated queries
Benchmark response time before and after optimization
Document performance improvements using measurable metrics

days.title: Security, Privacy & Guardrails
objectives: Secure chatbot APIs against unauthorized access
Validate and sanitize user inputs before processing
Protect sensitive healthcare information throughout the pipeline
Implement prompt-injection and jailbreak safeguards
Test common security scenarios and document mitigation strategies

days.title: Docker & Kubernetes Deployment
objectives: Containerize the chatbot backend and frontend using Docker
Deploy the application to a Kubernetes cluster
Configure health checks and environment variables
Verify the deployed chatbot functions correctly
Prepare the application for production hosting

days.title: Monitoring, Logging & Observability
objectives: Add structured logging throughout the chatbot pipeline
Monitor API performance and chatbot usage
Track failures, latency, and tool execution metrics
Build dashboards for production observability
Use monitoring insights to improve chatbot reliability

days.title: Production Readiness & Final Testing
objectives: Perform complete end-to-end testing of the chatbot
Validate retrieval, agent workflows, and frontend integration
Fix production issues discovered during testing
Complete deployment and operational documentation
Prepare the chatbot for real-world production usage

days.title: Capstone Project & Final Demo
objectives: Demonstrate the complete enterprise healthcare chatbot
Showcase retrieval, RAG, agents, MCP, and conversation memory
Present the deployed application with production architecture
Evaluate the chatbot using real-world scenarios
Publish the final project with source code and documentation
